assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready six-pose character sprite atlas for an original Chinese absurd meme arcade fighting game titled 战斗吧，大肥鱼. Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 PNG with genuinely transparent RGBA background. EXACT THREE columns and TWO rows, equal 512x512 cells, no grid lines. Six full-body versions of the SAME character, one in each cell. Order left to right top to bottom: ready stance, punch attack, kick attack, guard, hurt, signature special. Fixed orthographic side-view slightly three-quarter showing face, always facing SCREEN RIGHT. Compact three-head-tall chibi anatomy, expressive funny face, chunky dark navy ink outlines, crisp polished hand-drawn anime cel shading, saturated game colors, high readability at 150px tall. This is a coherent fighting sprite set, not realistic and not 3D. SAME character scale, costume, props and body proportions in all six cells. Each sprite entirely inside its own cell with at least 12% empty padding on all sides; no overlap between cells. Standing feet aligned at 85% cell height. Exactly two arms and two legs on each figure. No text, captions, labels, symbols resembling words, floor, ground shadow, scenery, panel border, checkerboard, motion blur, afterimages, glow or background decoration. Small props attached to the action are allowed but everything stays inside the cell. Each pose must have a strongly different readable silhouette. Subject: pompous stocky middle-aged male CLIENT BOSS, round beer belly stretching cream shirt, open burgundy suit jacket, navy trousers, shiny black shoes, gold tie clip, neatly slicked short black hair with one ridiculous curl, tiny rectangular glasses, fat eyebrows, smug ducklike pout. Big stack of revision papers with only abstract red correction marks (NO letters) used as a shield, short chunky red rubber stamp weapon. Poses: 1 ready smug with paper shield and stamp; 2 thrust a comically enlarged bare fist right, papers tucked under other arm; 3 short-legged furious front kick right, belly bouncing; 4 cowering behind paper stack like riot shield; 5 head recoils and cheeks wobble, glasses askew, stamp still held; 6 both hands overhead swinging a gigantic red rubber stamp down toward right, stamp head blank, furious deadline face. Humorous and cool, no other people.
assets.revisionPrompt: Edit this six-pose sprite atlas ONLY to fix cell padding and separation. Keep same character identity, same six poses in same order, same costume, face and colors, same crisp ink cel-shaded style. Output landscape 1536x1024 with genuinely transparent RGBA background. EXACT three equal columns by two equal rows, each cell 512x512. UNIFORMLY SHRINK ALL SIX FIGURES and attached props by 30%, maintaining relative character scale, and reposition each pose entirely inside its own cell. Preserve pose designs; do not add poses, props, effects, scenery, shadows, text, grid lines, checkerboard or labels. No colored backdrop. Real alpha transparency, retain clean complete outlines. This is a production sprite atlas that must be safe to slice into six equal square cells.
